title: The support minus the carrier is Hⁿ-null
statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ≥ 0, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} any set, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), W ⊆ U open, κ ∈ ℝ, H : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x, such that R.firstVariation X = −∫⟨X, H⟩dμ for every C¹ compactly supported X : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} with tsupport X ⊆ W. Then Hⁿ((spt μ ∩ W) ∖ M) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k)) (κ : ℝ), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → μHE[n] ((R.measure.support ∩ W) \ R.carrier) = 0
